items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: But Zutty, I want to hear some old, did you hear any old records I made with Mez?

ctx.x: But, there was no happy days in the world of playing like the good old New Orleans days. When they had that good old real ragtime funky jazz music day. But the funny thing Bill, New Orleans ain't got it no more. They ain't got the jazz. I don't know. Young kids, young boys don't look like they go, they don't want to fall in those timers shoes. They don't play that kind of music. They have a different style. But the other boys, like my boy Tony Peretti, another good boy, they all trying to carry the traditional…
